token_family_docs.$description: Dimmed mode collection, set by the product designer (DS consumer). Modes: off (the base, no class is applied) and on (.ob-dimmed-on). on gives parts of a page the light grey background; cards, fields, header and footer keep their own background. Each mode carries the CSS class string the application adds to a container to activate it.

selector.$description: off is the base dimmed mode: no class is applied. It is the first-paint default.
on is activated by a class the application adds to the container.
